title: Bound a EUR keyboard-generated text field
changes: Identify a conditional keyboard-driven writer of the live RAM field and bound the target byte sequence for valid selections from the authenticated keyboard.
validation: Wine e158-byte00-field-producers-dis-wine-74fsrd3b and e158-byte00-field-input-dis-wine-dj84lsa9 identify the original input writer and padding path.
Wine e158-byte00-keyboard-domain-wine-hlejcxyw checks 163 cells within declared navigation widths: only three 4073 codes are below 8000 and no adjacent pair of selected codes contains 40 67 01.
limitations: The bound assumes a field made exclusively from valid keyboard selections; initial/saved bytes, invalid selectors, aliases, other writers, callback invocation and ordinary byte00 use remain unproved. Linux, USA and native Windows pending. No performance measurement.
